Description: GATE-SHUTDOWN (D-314, 14/11/2026): the AWS gate is shut down; this stack keeps only the outputs bucket tower-outputs-<account>-<region>, retained (DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy Retain): the deployer writes the Lambda packages and the code bundle under artifacts/lambda/, and the service and the port read them. The gate's runner (the ECS service tower-runner, its task definition, roles and log group) is gone. The parameters stay, unused, because the deployer still passes them; DesiredCount 0 (parameters.json) is what the deploy smoke reads to skip the canary.

Image.Description: The service's image (the runner is its run-container command), as the deployer recorded it; read again at every deploy

LiveCode.Description: IMAGE-PREWARM-C: the code bundle the tasks boot (artifacts/lambda/tower-code/<sha256>.zip) and their TOWER_IMAGE_DIGEST, passed by deploy.sh when the deployed head's code is the bundle a landing swapped to; empty: the image's own code, its reference the digest

LiveSeen.Description: SLOW-PATH-NO-ROLLOUT-WAIT: deploy.live_code as deploy.sh read it when it deployed this task definition (TOWER_CODE_SEEN). A task boots the live code instead of this definition's only when the datum is another value, i.e. a landing swapped after this deploy; unknown: the deployer could not read it, the task never follows the datum. Not part of the stack's hash

Cpu.Description: CPU units of the warm runner: 2048 (2 vCPU) at 1 PR/min

Memory.Description: MiB of the warm runner: 8192, 2 GB for each of its four slots (AWS2; 4096 held two)

DesiredCount.Description: Warm runners (the capacity registered through the port gives one slot to each). 0 since the gate left AWS (the migration to GitHub, 14/11): infra/aws/parameters.json passes it on every deploy, so an apply of this stack never starts a runner again

LogDays.Description: Days a run's log stays in the bucket
